div.div:
Why the hard boundary
· GitLab CI never needs access to the private GKE endpoint — Flux pulls Git → cluster from inside (Door 3)
· Kubernetes CRDs inside Terraform state wedged plans/destroys
· Names, not lookups: orders-app@<proj>.iam.gserviceaccount.com is computable by both sides
